#include <bits/stdc++.h>

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int fast_pow(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (1LL * result * base) % MOD;
        base = (1LL * base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

const int M = 21;

int n;
int f_array[MAXN], g_array[MAXN];
int p_matrix[M][M];

int index_map[2][MAXN];
int reverse_mask[MAXN];
int match[M];
int adjacency[M][M];

void process(int *f, vector<int> left_nodes, vector<int> right_nodes, vector<int> subgraph, int *idx) {
    vector<pair<int, int>> edges;
    for (int x : left_nodes) {
        for (int y : right_nodes) {
            edges.emplace_back(x, y);
        }
    }

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (int)edges.size()); ++mask) {
        int probability = 1;
        int current_mask = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)edges.size(); ++i) {
            if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                probability = (1LL * probability * p_matrix[edges[i].first][edges[i].second]) % MOD;
                adjacency[edges[i].first][edges[i].second] = 1;
            } else {
                probability = (1LL * probability * (MOD + 1 - p_matrix[edges[i].first][edges[i].second])) % MOD;
                adjacency[edges[i].first][edges[i].second] = 0;
            }

            vector<int> perm, indices;
            for (int x : left_nodes) perm.push_back(x);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) if (gr & (1 << i)) indices.push_back(i + n);
            bool found = false;
            do {
                bool valid = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)perm.size(); ++i) {
                    if (!adj[perm[i]][indices[i]]) {
                        valid = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (valid) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            } while (next_permutation(indices.begin(), indices.end()));
            if (found) current_mask |= (1 << idx[gr]);
        }
        f[current_mask] = (f[current_mask] + probability) % MOD;
    }
}

    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> p_matrix[i][j + n];
            p_matrix[i][j + n] = (1LL * p_matrix[i][j + n] * fast_pow(100, MOD - 2)) % MOD;
        }

        cout << p_matrix[0][1] << "\n";

            index_map[0][mask] = count1++;
            subset1.push_back(mask);
        }
        if (__builtin_popcount(mask) == half2) {
            index_map[1][mask] = count2++;
            subset2.push_back(mask);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)subset2.size(); ++i) {
        int mask = subset2[i];
        for (int big_mask = 0; big_mask < (1 << count2); ++big_mask) {
            if (big_mask & (1 << i))
                reverse_mask[big_mask] |= (1 << index_map[0][(1 << n) - 1 - mask]);
        }
    }

    for (int i = n; i < 2 * n; ++i) {
        right_part.push_back(i);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < half1; ++i) left_part1.push_back(i);
    for (int i = half1; i < n; ++i) left_part2.push_back(i);

    process(f_array, left_part1, right_part, subset1, index_map[0]);
    process(g_array, left_part2, right_part, subset2, index_map[1]);

    for (int i = 0; i < count1; ++i) {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << count1); ++mask) {
            if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                f_array[mask] = (f_array[mask] + f_array[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << count2); ++mask) {
        int w = (1 - f_array[(1 << count1) - 1 - reverse_mask[mask]] + MOD) % MOD;
        answer = (answer + 1LL * w * g_array[mask]) % MOD;
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";
